name: tobin-superpowers-dev
description: Marketplace for tobin-superpowers, an independent extension to the official superpowers plugin

plugins.name: tobin-superpowers
plugins.description: Extension for the official superpowers plugin: auto-loads hybrid planning preferences, gives advisory validation of implementation plans, injects code standards and a lint baseline into plans, asks before new packages are installed, and offers optional shareable HTML companions for specs, plans, code reviews, and run summaries, and provides a manual, approval-gated workflow for promoting skills into portable ones. Requires superpowers; does not replace its skills.
